title: debark plugin protocol v1
description: debark.plugin/v1 - the out-of-process, language-agnostic plugin protocol carried as single-line JSON over stdio (ADR-009). A plugin prints a Handshake on start, then answers Requests with Responses, one JSON object per line, until its stdin closes. This schema's top level validates any one wire message: a Handshake, a Request, or a Response. The $defs SignParams, SignResult, KeyInfoResult and Error describe the method-specific payloads carried inside Request.params and Response.result (both typed as free-form JSON on the wire, since their shape depends on the method field) and are referenced here for documentation; a host implementation dispatches on method to pick the right one. Only the sign capability is defined in v1.

capabilities.description: What this plugin can do. "sign" is the only capability defined in v1; the list is open for forward compatibility, and the host refuses to call a method whose capability was not announced.

id.description: Correlates a response with its request. Generated by the host.

method.description: sign asks the plugin to sign params.payload; key_info asks for the key identity without signing; shutdown asks the plugin to exit cleanly.

params.description: Method-specific parameters. sign carries $defs/SignParams; key_info and shutdown carry none.

id.description: Echoes the id of the request this responds to.

result.description: Present on success. sign returns $defs/SignResult; key_info returns $defs/KeyInfoResult; shutdown returns an empty object. Exactly one of result and error is set.

error.description: Present on failure. Exactly one of result and error is set.

code.description: Short stable identifier for the failure.

purpose.description: Domain-separation string, e.g. debark.manifest/v1. A plugin must incorporate it into what it signs, or refuse.

payload.description: Standard base64 of the canonical bytes to sign.

key_ref.description: The operator's key selector, passed through verbatim.

signature.description: Standard base64 of the raw signature bytes.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm, e.g. ed25519 or ecdsa-p256-sha256.

signer_kind.description: Recorded in the manifest signature block; when empty the host records plugin:<name>. Not pattern-constrained here: a plugin may report a kind the host does not yet recognise.

public_key.description: Standard base64 of the raw public key, when the plugin can export one; an HSM may not.
